score_interpretation.1_3: LOW TRUST (Insufficient evidence, missing mandatory fields, or unsupported claims)
score_interpretation.4_6: MODERATE TRUST (Sufficient evidence, uncalibrated rule < 30 cases, human review required)
score_interpretation.7_8: HIGH TRUST (Sufficient evidence, verified claims, calibrated rule >= 30 cases)
score_interpretation.9_10: VERY HIGH TRUST (Multi-source corroboration, calibrated rule, high accuracy)

dimensions.description: Percentage of model claims verified by canonical evidence
EDR vs Firewall vs Syslog vs Synthetic provenance score
Absence of unacknowledged contradictions in telemetry
Historical selective accuracy and calibration state

invariants: Missing mandatory contract evidence strictly clamps score to <= 3/10
Uncalibrated rule (< 30 verified cases) strictly clamps score to <= 6/10
Autonomous decision eligibility strictly requires trust_score >= 7 AND calibrated state
